mel_coo.entry_format: {mel_ch s6, bin_idx s11, weight int16 Q1.15}
mel_coo.source: librosa.filters.mel(sr=44100, n_fft=2048, n_mels=64, fmin=0, fmax=22050, htk=False, norm='slaney')
mel_coo.canonical_bytes: (bin_idx, weight) int16 LE pairs x n_entries

exp_lut.domain: Q6.9 softmax difference d in [-16, 0]; index i covers d = -i/32 (step 1/32 = 16 Q6.9 LSBs)
